sportsdataverse.golf — 21 endpoints. Note: Runtime only: each call sends one GraphQL query to orchestrator.pgatour.com/graphql. sdv-py publishes no release assets from this API and ships no bulk or backfill tooling for it. Note: The request body is {operationName, query, variables}; the query document ships in sportsdataverse/golf/pgatour_queries/. Every request also carries an x-api-key header (left out of the example request): the public key pgatour.com's own frontend sends, read from the site on first use. Set the PGA_API_KEY environment variable to supply a key yourself. Note: Tour codes: R PGA TOUR, S PGA TOUR Champions, H Korn Ferry Tour. Tournament ids are the tour code, the season and the event number (R2026014 is the 2026 Masters): read them from pgatour_schedule.

Tournament headers: one row per tournament id (name, dates, status, current round, format, city, time zone). Endpoint URL: POST https://orchestrator.pgatour.com/graphql Example request: curl -X POST 'https://orchestrator.pgatour.com/graphql' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"operationName": "Tournaments", "query": "query Tournaments($ids: [ID!]) {
 tournaments(ids: $ids) {
 id
 tournamentName
 seasonYear
 displayDate
 tournamentStatus
 roundStatus
 roundDisplay
 currentRound
 formatType
 scoredLevel
 city
 state
 country
 timezone
 tournamentLocation
 }
}
", "variables": {"ids": ["R2026014"]}}'
